{{Quote|How much of this private storehouse did you see?''"<br />"''Not much more than the route between the entrance and the throne room at the top. But I know where the Spaarti cylinder chamber is.|Han Solo and Mara Jade|<ref name="TLC" />}}
'''Cloning Chamber''' was a chamber located within the immense cavern in the middle levels of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], which consisted of multiple balcony levels built in stadium-style rows.

==History==
The cloning chamber was destroyed in an [[Assault on Mount Tantiss|attack]] on [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Smugglers' Alliance]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TLCS" /> Several [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]]<ref name="Erasing All Traces">{{WEGCite|story=Erasing All Traces|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> after the destruction of the mountain, the [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Garv Debble]] and his [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] [[Milanda Vorgan]] of the [[New Republic Xenoarchaeology Division]] undertook an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] expedition known as the [[Mount Tantiss dig]].<ref name="Field Report">{{WEGCite|story=Field Report|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] later mentioned the cloning chamber in<ref name="Field Report" /> his<ref name="CSWE Na'al">{{CSWECite|II|351|Na'al, Voren}}</ref> [[Voren Na'al's journal|journal]].<ref name="Field Report" />

==Layout==
[[File:Spaarti_cylinders_plan.png|thumb|left|250px|Complete technical readout of the Cloning Chamber in Mount Tantiss.]]
The top level of the chamber was a control and maintenance area, with each of the lower levels containing row upon row of [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|Spaarti cylinders]]. Each level's circular balcony stretched further toward the center of the cavern than the previous level, much like a stadium. Running through the center of the cavern was a huge column, which housed the immense power distribution and nutrient feeder systems. Piping, power lines and waste removal tubes filled the cloning chamber, running from the central column to each balcony. Each balcony had four retractable bridges, which could be extended to the central column. Each level also had nearly two dozen doors, allowing access from the outside. The Spaarti cylinders were arranged in groups of four, attached to overhead nutrient feed pipes and power conduits. Each cluster of Spaarti cylinders was overlooked by a [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]] on a [[nutrient frame]].<ref name="TLCS" />
